name: mnemon
description: Persistent code & research oracle subagents that hold whole files, pages, and repos in their own context and answer your follow-up questions, optionally scoped by a code-review-graph structural graph

interface.shortDescription: Persistent oracle subagents for context-cheap code and research investigation
interface.longDescription: Spawn a subagent that reads files, web pages, or a whole repo fully into its own context, keep it alive, and ask it follow-up questions — it answers with file:line / URL citations while your own context stays clean. Optionally scoped by a code-review-graph structural graph.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand how this module works without filling my context.
Research the current state of <topic> and keep it on tap for follow-ups.
